Character.description: A node representing a character in a fictional universe.

Film.description: A film entity in the Neo4j graph database, representing a movie or TV show.

Planet.description: A planet in the universe, characterized by its unique properties such as gravity, terrain, population, orbital period, surface water, diameter, URL, name, climate, and rotation period.

Species.description: A node representing a species in a fictional universe.

Starship.description: A starship in a search system.

Vehicle.description: A vehicle in a search system.

APPEARED_IN.description: A relationship between a planet, species, character, starship, or vehicle and a film in which they appeared.

HOMEWORLD.description: A relationship between a species and a planet where the species is born and raised.

OF.description: A relationship between a character and a species.

PILOT.description: A relationship between a character and a starship or vehicle they are piloting.

Character.id.description: A unique identifier for the character.

Character.created.description: The date the character was created.

Character.edited.description: The date the character was last edited.

Character.url.description: A URL to the character's profile.

Character.birth_year.description: The year the character was born.

Character.eye_color.description: The color of the character's eyes.

Character.skin_color.description: The color of the character's skin.

Character.hair_color.description: The color of the character's hair.

Film.id.description: A unique identifier for the film.

Film.created.description: The date and time the film was created.

Film.edited.description: The date and time the film was last edited.

Film.url.description: A URL to the film's official website.

Film.producer.description: The name of the film's producer.

Film.release_date.description: The release date of the film.

Film.director.description: The name of the film's director.

Film.opening_crawl.description: A brief summary of the film's opening scene.

Planet.id.description: A unique identifier for the planet.

Planet.created.description: The date and time when the planet was created.

Planet.edited.description: The date and time when the planet was last edited.

Planet.gravity.description: The gravitational force acting on the planet.

Planet.terrain.description: The type of terrain on the planet.

Planet.population.description: The number of inhabitants on the planet.

Planet.orbital_period.description: The time it takes for the planet to complete one orbit around its star.

Planet.surface_water.description: The percentage of the planet's surface that is covered in water.

Planet.url.description: The URL of the planet's Wikipedia page.

Planet.rotation_period.description: The time it takes for the planet to complete one rotation on its axis.

Species.id.description: A unique identifier for the species.

Species.created.description: The date the species was created.

Species.edited.description: The date the species was last edited.

Species.url.description: A URL to the species's Wikipedia page.

Species.designation.description: A designation for the species, such as 'common name' or 'scientific name'.

Species.hair_colors.description: The colors of the species's hair.

Species.average_lifespan.description: The average lifespan of the species.

Species.language.description: The language spoken by the species.

Species.classification.description: The classification of the species, such as 'mammal', 'reptile', 'insect'.

Species.skin_colors.description: The colors of the species's skin.

Species.eye_colors.description: The colors of the species's eyes.

Species.average_height.description: The average height of the species.

Starship.id.description: A unique identifier for the starship.

Starship.created.description: The date and time the starship was created.

Starship.edited.description: The date and time the starship was last edited.

Starship.url.description: The URL of the starship's page.

Starship.consumables.description: The amount of consumables the starship can carry.

Starship.max_atmosphering_speed.description: The maximum speed of the starship in atmospheres per hour.

Starship.cargo_capacity.description: The maximum cargo capacity of the starship.

Starship.passengers.description: The number of passengers the starship can carry.

Starship.MGLT.description: The maximum number of minutes per hour that the starship can travel.

Starship.hyperdrive_rating.description: The rating of the starship's hyperdrive.

Starship.length.description: The length of the starship in meters.

Starship.crew.description: The number of crew members on the starship.

Starship.cost_in_credits.description: The cost of the starship in credits.

Vehicle.id.description: A unique identifier for the vehicle.

Vehicle.created.description: The date and time the vehicle was created.

Vehicle.edited.description: The date and time the vehicle was last edited.

Vehicle.url.description: A URL to the vehicle's information.

Vehicle.consumables.description: The amount of consumables the vehicle can carry.

Vehicle.max_atmosphering_speed.description: The maximum speed of the vehicle in atmospheres.

Vehicle.cargo_capacity.description: The maximum cargo capacity of the vehicle.

Vehicle.passengers.description: The number of passengers the vehicle can carry.

Vehicle.crew.description: The number of crew members on the vehicle.

Vehicle.cost_in_credits.description: The cost of the vehicle in credits.
